full_query: How long does this years flu usually last?

shared_context.topic: duration of this year's flu season

sentences: The duration of a typical flu season can vary, but it generally lasts about six to eight weeks from the peak of flu activity
Flu seasons usually begin in the fall and can last until spring
Influenza activity can be predicted and tracked geographically, with the season typically occurring during the colder months in each hemisphere
For each specific location, minor epidemics usually take about three weeks to reach their peak and another three weeks to significantly diminish
The flu virus is transmitted throughout populations all year round, although the incidence of flu cases increases tenfold or more during periods of cooler temperatures
Annually, about 3 to 5 million cases of severe illness and 290,000 to 650,000 deaths from seasonal flu occur worldwide
